card.title: Sent to integrations
card.subtitle: What happened to this order, as your integrations were told. Kept for 90 days.
card.load_error: The events could not be loaded.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Who receives your store's events, and how each delivery went.
integrations.none: No integration receives your store's events yet.
integrations.load_error: The integrations could not be loaded.
integrations.limit: A store can have up to {max} webhooks. Delete one to add another.

status.stopped_failing: Stopped: every delivery failed for 3 days
status.stopped_gone: Stopped: the endpoint said it is gone (HTTP 410)
status.stopped_bot_blocked: Stopped: the Telegram chat blocked the bot
status.stopped_not_connected: Stopped: no Telegram chat is connected yet

stop_confirm.title: Stop {name}?
stop_confirm.body: It receives nothing while stopped, and what is waiting is skipped. Start it again and deliver what it missed with “Deliver again”.

replay.title: Deliver events again
replay.body: Every event in this range that {name} receives is delivered to it again, its attempts started over. Events are numbered in the order they happened.
replay.reversed: The first event comes before the last.
replay.too_long: Deliver at most 1,000 events at a time.

retry.done: The delivery is on its way again.

errors.already_due: This delivery is already on its way.
errors.generic: That did not work. Try again.
errors.built_in: This integration is managed by its own settings.
errors.limit_reached: Your store already has as many webhooks as it can. Delete one first.
errors.not_found: This integration no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.invalid: Check the fields and try again.

webhook.create_body: Your own system receives your store's events: each one is POSTed to its address as JSON, signed so it can check it came from your store.
webhook.name: Name
webhook.url_hint: A public https address on your server.
webhook.every_event: Every event, including ones added later
webhook.every_order: All order events, including ones added later
webhook.every_shipment: All delivery events, including ones added later

url_problem.invalid: Enter a full address, starting with https://
url_problem.credentials: Remove the user name and password from the address: each request is proven by its signature.
url_problem.private_host: Use an address on the public internet, not a local or private one.

secret.created_title: Webhook added: copy its signing secret
secret.body: Your endpoint uses it to check each request comes from your store. It is shown only now: keep it in your server's secrets.
secret.rotated_body: Switch your endpoint to it. The previous secret keeps signing requests too, so none is refused meanwhile, and stops {time}.

rotate_confirm.title: Change the signing secret of {name}?
rotate_confirm.body: A new secret is made. For a day, each request is signed with both; after that, only with the new one.

delete_confirm.title: Delete {name}?
delete_confirm.body: It stops receiving events, and its delivery history is deleted. Your store's events are kept.

test.title: Send a test event
test.body: An example event is sent now to the address below, signed like a real one. Its event number is 0 and its id starts with test_, so your endpoint can tell it apart.
test.delivered: Delivered: your endpoint answered HTTP {status} in {ms} ms.

page.subtitle: Send your orders and deliveries to the tools you use, as they happen.
page.empty_body: Your server receives each order and delivery step as it happens.
page.webhooks_subtitle: Your own systems, told of the events you choose.

api_key.title: Store API key
api_key.subtitle: Read-only key used by your storefront to authenticate with the API
api_key.label: Storefront API key
api_key.missing: API key not available. It will appear here after your next re-deployment.
